executive_summary: Maven build failed with 43 compilation errors due to missing critical dependencies. Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, Jakarta Persistence, and Apache Commons Lang3 packages are not found. The root cause is incomplete or missing dependency declarations in pom.xml. All errors can be resolved by adding the required dependencies to the Maven configuration.

errors.root_cause: Spring Security dependency is missing from pom.xml. Multiple security-related packages cannot be found including HttpSecurity, SecurityFilterChain, and EnableWebSecurity.
Spring Data JPA dependency is missing from pom.xml. JpaRepository, Modifying, Query, and Param annotations cannot be found across multiple repository classes.
Jakarta Persistence API is missing. Entity, Table, Id, and other JPA annotations cannot be found. This is typically included with spring-boot-starter-data-jpa but may need explicit declaration.
errors.fix_recommendation: Ensure spring-boot-starter-data-jpa is added to pom.xml (includes Jakarta Persistence). If issue persists, add explicit dependency: <dependency><groupId>jakarta.persistence</groupId><artifactId>jakarta.persistence-api</artifactId></dependency>

errors.root_cause: Apache Commons Lang3 library is missing from pom.xml. This utility library is required by ValidationUtils class.
